quotes.text: Our wedding was perfect on The Spirit of Ethan Allen! The employees were courteous, helpful, and more than accommodating with anything we needed throughout the evening. The food was excellent and fresh (guests were raving about it after dinner) and they did a great job decorating the boat deck as we had planned! I would highly recommend this beautiful venue for a wedding!
